purpose: Mario is not a scene-closure behavior, so his own sounds never enter a level's sfx_ids. compile_catalog merges this set into the loaded closure document (never into the closure file on disk) so the resident SFX bundle can resolve the sounds his actions request.
sizing: Measured 2026-09-03 with the bake's own resolver against BOB's bundle: actions 11 sounds / 6 samples / 36,512 B at source rate, voice 18 sounds / 17 samples / 210,272 B at 16 kHz. Both banks are SFX-only, so the owner-approved 2:1 closure decimation applies: ~123 KB resident against 218,295 B of PCM headroom.

deliberately_omitted.SOUND_ACTION_TERRAIN_HEAVY_LANDING: unbakeable: its sound-player subroutine (.heavy_landing_common) mutates instrument state, which _resolve_closure_sfx refuses by design
deliberately_omitted.extra voice (EEUH, HAHA, UH2, ON_FIRE, P: 165,632 B at 16 kHz for sounds BOB rarely or never triggers; Saturn-shaped means these stay out until a level needs them

known_limitation: SM64 adds a per-terrain offset (mario_get_terrain_sound_addend, up to 8 variants) to TERRAIN_JUMP/LANDING/STEP/BODY_HIT_GROUND with no define per variant, and the bake keys sounds on declared symbols, so only the default-addend variant (BOB's grass) resolves. Stone/slippery-floor footsteps stay silent until the bake can key symbol+offset variants.
